title: Longest Increasing Path in a Matrix
inputFormat: Implement longestIncreasingPathInAMatrix(matrix). Receive a nonempty rectangular matrix of integers.
outputFormat: Return the maximum number of cells in any strictly increasing path, including its starting cell.
